# v1.0.10

## Added

- **Update notifications.** EVE-F-Preview now checks GitHub for a newer release on startup and every 12 hours. When one exists, a popup tells you and links to the release page, and an "Update available" link appears on the About tab. It's notice-only - nothing is downloaded or installed automatically.
  - The popup has a **Don't show again for this version** checkbox. A later release will still notify you.
  - Turn the check off entirely with **Check for updates** on the General tab.
